description: >
  Internationalization (i18n): multi-language support via useI18n() composable, $t() Vue plugin,
  data-i18n DOM attributes.  JSON translation files per language under public/configs/i18n/.
  i18n key conventions: text-* for plain text, html-* for rich text, hast-* for HAST JSON.
  Use when: adding translations, modifying useI18n.ts, i18n plugin, or language switching.
applyTo: >
  src/composables/useI18n.ts;
  src/plugins/i18n.ts;
  src/core/i18n.ts;
  public/configs/i18n/**
---

#### 4.1.1 I18n (Internationalization)

##### 4.1.1.1 Architecture

```
useI18n() composable         i18nPlugin (app.use)
  ├─ locale: Ref<Lang>         └─ provide(I18N_LOCALE_KEY)
  ├─ messages: Ref<...>           provide(I18N_MESSAGES_KEY)
  ├─ t(key, fallback?)            register $t() global
  ├─ setLocale(rawLang)          ─┐
  └─ syncFromLangData()           │ legacy compat
                                  │
core/i18n.ts                      │
  ├─ langData: Record<...>        │
  ├─ currentLang: Lang            │
  ├─ applyLangData(lang, data) <-─┘
  └─ normalizeLang(raw)
```

##### 4.1.1.2 i18n Key Naming

| Prefix   | Target        | Example                      |
| -------- | ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `text-*` | `textContent` | `text-home`, `text-settings` |
| `html-*` | `innerHTML`   | `html-steve-hsu-s-link-hub`  |
| `hast-*` | HAST render   | `hast-powered-by`            |

##### 4.1.1.3 setLocale() Flow

1. `window.__loadingBar.show()` (if bridge is set up)
2. `fetch(/configs/i18n/{lang}.json)`
3. On success: `applyLangData(lang, data)` + `window.__loadingBar.complete()`
4. On error: `window.__loadingBar.hide()` + `showToast("error", ...)`

##### 4.1.1.4 Language Switching via AppNavbar

AppNavbar calls `setLocale(lang)` directly in `switchLanguage()`. During
initial bootstrap, `initLang()` (legacy) calls `applyLangData()` first, then
`syncFromLangData()` syncs the Vue messages ref.

##### 4.1.1.5 Translation JSON Format

```json
{
  "text-home": "Home",
  "html-steve-hsu-s-link-hub": "<strong>Steve Hsu</strong>'s Link-Hub",
  "hast-powered-by": {
    "type": "element",
    "tagName": "span",
    "children": [/* HAST nodes */]
  }
}
```

##### 4.1.1.6 Consumers

| File                           | How                                           |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `App.vue`                      | `useI18n()` -> `syncFromLangData()`           |
| `AppNavbar.vue`                | `useI18n()` -> `setLocale()`, `t()`, `locale` |
| `SettingsModal.vue`            | `useI18n()` -> `setLocale()`, `locale`        |
| `FooterNav.vue`                | `useI18n()` -> `messages`, `t()`, `$t()`      |
| `ResetWarningModal.vue`        | `useI18n()` -> `t()`                          |
| `ScrollHint.vue`               | `useI18n()` -> `t()`                          |
| `ExternalLinkConfirmModal.vue` | `useI18n()` -> `t()`, `$t()`                  |
| `QRCodeModal.vue`              | `useI18n()` -> `t()`, `$t()`                  |
